description: Find appointment availability — which staff can deliver the given session types, where, and in which time windows. Use before mindbody_add_appointment. Mindbody: GET /appointment/bookableitems.

appointment_id.description: Exclude this existing appointment (useful when rescheduling).

end_date.description: End of the range (default start_date) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

ignore_default_session_length.description: Also return availabilities that differ from the session type's default length.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

session_type_ids.description: Session type ids to find availability for (see mindbody_list_session_types).

staff_ids.description: Only these staff ids (omit for all staff).

start_date.description: Start of the range (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

name: mindbody_list_bookable_items
title: Find bookable appointment slots
